dependencies.python: collections.deque; numpy for the randomised invariant test. No new dependencies.

story-context.constraints: - One new file under src/: protocol/redemption.py. Tests: tests/test_redemption.py, tests/test_redemption_integration.py. - Capacity is in stable units per step; payout is in reference units. Do not mix. - Paid amounts are recorded at fill time; changing spread later never alters history. - reserves_exhausted requires reserves effectively zero AND a non-empty queue; latches; emits once. - FIFO strictly; partial fills keep the remainder at the head. - Construction raises ValueError; execute/on_phase never raise for domain reasons. - Must NOT implement PegView (test isinstance False). - phases == frozenset({EXECUTION, PROTOCOL_EVENTS}); on_phase does nothing in EXECUTION. - Python 3.12-compatible.

source: str; amount: float; remaining: float; step_requested: int
